plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Run a structured debate between any Claude Code skills/commands acting as personas. The skill spawns one subagent per participant, runs opening positions in parallel, identifies real clashes via a neutral facilitator, runs rebuttal rounds, and delivers a verdict.
